title: continuous wave transition and readable side HUD
problem_statement: Wave completion currently triggers a blocking level overlay and engine stop; the player needs continuous level transitions plus readable level/score/wave progress feedback without changing wave-based progression.
game_flow_context: waves / level up feedback / HUD / score readability / onion pressure
validated_decisions: Speed Dot is already implemented and must not be redesigned in this iteration.
Wave completion remains based on finite budget exhausted plus zero pressure onions.
Level transition must become continuous and non-blocking.
A minimal side panel or HUD is explicitly in scope for this task despite the older contract listing HUD wave meter as out of scope by default.
draft_assumptions_in_play: DOM side panel is likely acceptable because index.html already has side panels and overlays.
Canvas HUD can be used if it is smaller and less invasive, but current canvas HUD appears minimal and not clearly sufficient for side-panel readability.
Existing level overlay may remain for other flows if still used, but must not be used as the wave-completion transition.
Existing dirty worktree changes are external input and must not be reverted.
resetGame(nextLevel, false) is accepted as the v1 transition primitive if impact review confirms the player/bullet reset tradeoff is acceptable.
DOM HUD is the preferred implementation path unless impact review finds a concrete layout blocker.
Impact-regression-guard LOG-004 approves routing to build with strict file/scope constraints.
Build-agent LOG-006 proposes BUILD_DONE; task-orchestrator routes to review-maintainability-guard.
Review-maintainability-guard LOG-008 verdict is APPROVE_WITH_NOTES with status proposal DONE.
current_direction: Add LevelManager.getWaveProgress() as a read-only API with derived current level, spawned budget, total budget, active pressure count, cleared/remaining/queued onions, progress ratio and completion.
Implement HUD ownership in main.js with DOM targets from index.html; keep HUD read-only and out of progression/scoring decisions.
Replace only the wave-completion calls that block gameplay: fadeBgm(0, 800), engine.stop() and showLevelOverlay(nextLevel).
Keep showLevelOverlay() infrastructure for now; no wave-completion path may call it.
Use non-blocking toast/status feedback that does not affect isOverlayActive() and does not capture input.
Keep Speed Dot behavior and current rendering layer; current two drawSpeedDot() call sites are mutually exclusive branches unless impact review proves otherwise.
Build is approved with guard constraints from LOG-004.
Build must add explicit maxLevel/localStorage update for continuous transitions.
Build must keep level-up toast non-blocking, outside isOverlayActive(), and unable to capture input.
Build must keep HUD read-only; HUD must not drive progression, score or wave completion.

notes: Pending human browser tests remain recommended before treating audio/input/game-feel as human-verified.
Dirty worktree outside scope remains unnormalized by this task.

pending_human_browser_tests: Goto, pause, gameover and continue flows.
build_report_summary: LOG-006 reports changes in js/core/LevelManager.js, main.js, index.html, css/game.css and thread log only.
LOG-006 reports js/ui/canvas.js was inspected but not modified.
LOG-006 reports LevelManager.getWaveProgress(), continuous non-blocking wave transition, explicit maxLevel/localStorage sync, non-blocking level toast/audio fade lifecycle, and read-only DOM HUD.
LOG-006 reports drawHUD() removal after rg confirmation.
LOG-006 reports forbidden files were not edited by this build, while pre-existing dirty Player/Onion changes remain outside scope.
approved_runtime_changes: Expose a read-only LevelManager.getWaveProgress() API derived from existing waveState and getPressureOnionCount().
On wave completion, keep the engine running and remove only the blocking wave-completion effects: fadeBgm(0, 800), engine.stop(), and showLevelOverlay(nextLevel).
Advance with resetGame(nextLevel, false) as v1 transition primitive, preserving score/game time/counters while accepting that player, bullets, onions, arena and Speed Dot are rebuilt.
Play level-up SFX and stop/fade it through a new non-blocking toast lifecycle, not through hideLevelOverlay().
Add explicit stats.maxLevel and localStorage pi_max_level update after continuous transition.
Add DOM HUD updates in main.js that read LevelManager/state and display LV, OPINION, NEXT WAVE progress and ONIONS, without driving progression.
Keep showLevelOverlay()/hideLevelOverlay() infrastructure, but no wave-completion path may call showLevelOverlay().
Keep Speed Dot update, pickup, targeting, config and draw layering behavior unchanged.
data_tuning_changes: No maxAliveOnions, totalOnions, spawnIntervalMs, bullet bounce or Speed Dot config changes.
No asset, sound or copy-heavy content production.
build_constraints: Edit only approved impact surface files.
Use js/ui/canvas.js only if implementation/manual layout check proves a responsive sizing issue; if touched, limit edits to sizing math.
Do not edit forbidden files or normalize unrelated dirty worktree changes.
If implementation requires Player/Bullet/Onion/OnionAI, config, assets/sounds or network/presence files, stop and return BLOCKED to task-orchestrator.
Before deleting drawHUD(), re-run rg and confirm no call site.
Do not add the toast to isOverlayActive() and ensure it cannot capture pointer/keyboard input.
explicit_non_goals: No shop, upgrades, interstitials, recap screens or new mechanics.
No level config tuning in config/levels.json unless a blocking bug is found and justified.
No physical continuity rewrite that preserves player position/bullets across waves.
No edits to js/ui/canvas.js unless the sizing issue is proven during build.
approved_impact_surface: js/ui/canvas.js only if implementation/manual layout check proves the side panel cannot fit without a narrow responsive sizing fix
forbidden_files: config/levels.json unless a blocking data defect is proven and routed back through task-orchestrator
freeze_zones: Speed Dot behavior except confirmed duplicate draw/integration fix.
backward_compatibility_concerns: resetGame(level, false) currently rebuilds player, onions and arena; gameplay-programmer must decide whether continuous transition can use it without breaking player continuity expectations.
showLevelOverlay currently restarts engine after timeout and is referenced by overlay/pause logic; removing or bypassing it must not break goto/gameover/loading flows.
isOverlayActive treats level overlay as blocking; new level-up feedback must not be represented as a blocking overlay.
drawSpeedDot appears in both clipped-arena and fallback drawing branches; gameplay-programmer must confirm whether this is duplicate same-frame draw or mutually exclusive branches.
gameplay-programmer LOG-002 reports the drawSpeedDot branches are mutually exclusive in one draw call; impact-regression-guard must verify this before approving build.
resetGame(nextLevel, false) preserves score/time but rebuilds player, onions, arena and Speed Dot; this v1 tradeoff must be reviewed explicitly.
Removing the overlay path means level-up SFX must be stopped/faded by new non-blocking feedback lifecycle.
Continuous transitions need explicit maxLevel/localStorage update because startEngineIfReady() may return while engine is already running.
Permanent side HUD can overflow current flex layout; impact review must decide whether css alone is sufficient or js/ui/canvas.js sizing is allowed.
Worktree already has unrelated modifications in gameplay files; next owner must not revert them.
required_validations: node --input-type=module --check < changed-js-file> for every changed JS file
JSON parse only if a JSON file is changed
manual browser smoke test of continuous wave completion
PHPMD not applicable unless PHP files/config are actually introduced or discovered
human_test_checklist: Complete a wave and confirm the next wave starts without engine stop.
Confirm no blocking level overlay appears on wave completion.
Confirm movement/input remains active through level-up feedback.
Confirm HUD/panel shows LV, OPINION, NEXT WAVE progress and ONIONS remaining or completed/total.
Confirm progression still advances only on wave completion.
Confirm Speed Dot still spawns, renders once at the intended layer, can be collected, and keeps previous behavior.
Smoke-check onion spawn/cap/cadence, chase, collisions, bullets and game over.
Confirm goto overlay, pause/resume, play again and continue still work.
Confirm desktop and <=900px layouts do not overlap HUD, canvas or touch controls.
Confirm stats.maxLevel and localStorage.pi_max_level update immediately after continuous transition.
Confirm level-up SFX stops/fades without relying on #level-overlay.visible.
solution_applied: LevelManager.getWaveProgress() added as a read-only derived wave progress API.
Wave completion now advances continuously via resetGame(nextLevel, false) without engine.stop(), showLevelOverlay(nextLevel), or fadeBgm(0, 800) in the wave-complete branch.
Explicit maxLevel/localStorage sync added for continuous transitions.
Non-blocking level toast added outside isOverlayActive() with independent level-up SFX fade lifecycle.
Read-only DOM HUD added for LV, OPINION, NEXT WAVE progress and ONIONS.
Review-maintainability-guard approved with notes in LOG-008; no rework required.
